## Requirements
Requirement id to satisfy + stamp: **R-2.1.2** (§3.1) — the Harness IR (HIR/1).
C0/Stage-1 slice (§3.1.14): HIR/1 schema (13 entities, 2 leaves, 7 edges, provenance + version
records on every node/edge), `validate`, `canonicalize`, `identity`, `seal`,
`diff`/`apply`/`invert`/`classify`, `migrate` (identity only), `project`, and the
`AgentProcess` sum + `OpaqueProcess` schema. Deferred by spec staging (NOT this ticket):
`opacity`/`ablate` (Stage 3), `rebase` (C1/Stage 2+), OpaqueProcess population/probing and
agent-spec export/import (C2/Stage 4).

## Acceptance criteria
Gating (§3.1.12), deterministic: AC-IR-01, -02, -04, -05, -06, -07, -10.
- AC-IR-01: schema = exactly 13 entities + 2 leaves + 7 edges + provenance/version records;
  every §3.1.4 invariant a `validate` check; every kind carries `since = HIR/1`.
- AC-IR-02 (T-01): two-profile compile differs only in `surface`; no schema field typed by
  model identity outside `ProfileRef` — Stage-1 half: the surface/semantic split + the static
  T-LCD-01 field check (the two-profile *compile* needs §3.2, Stage 3).
- AC-IR-04 (T-06): no dependency edge to the Hosting ABI; `OpaqueProcess` defined in the IR.
- AC-IR-05 (T-10): rename/reorder-args/reword-template ⇒ `semantic_ops = ∅`, `semantic_id`
  unchanged.
- AC-IR-06: `canonicalize` byte-identical across implementations on ≥100 definitions;
  `apply(base, diff(base,target)) = target` and `apply(target, invert(diff)) = base`.
- AC-IR-07: `EffectUncovered`; `ConditionedRuleIncomplete`; delegation exceeding parent's
  Permission/Budget fails.
- AC-IR-10 (T-12): every §3.1.7 op specified and runs out-of-process over canonical encoding.

Universal phase-gate AC as usual. Cross-cutting invariants re-checked (CC8 anchors here:
dialect bumps + migration are the enum-growth mechanism; CC10: per-kind `classify_home` table).

## Plan
1. `hh-ontology::planes`: publish `IrEntityKind` (15) + the §3.1.3 home table; extend
   `classify_home`/`classify_home_identifier`/`registered_kinds`; close DF-S1.1-1.
   Leaf homes (spec silent; deferral wants them homed): `Text`→P1, `CompiledPayload`→P2 —
   interim under ADR-0216/OQ-467, decision recorded in a build ADR.
2. `hh-provenance`: `MintingContext{closed_world_tools}` + `default_authority_in` (CC8
   additive — `default_authority` delegates with an empty context); `tool` mints
   `environment` when the capability is declared closed-world in a sealed definition.
   Closes DF-S1.3-3.
3. New persistent crate `crates/hh-hir` (deps: hh-wire, hh-identity, hh-provenance,
   hh-ontology): kinds/records/leaves/document + JSON schema (to_json/from_json),
   `identity` (two ids over idp/1), `canonicalize`, `validate` (full §3.1.4 battery +
   error set), `seal` (→ definition authority, all refs pinned), `diff`/`apply`/`invert`/
   `classify` (`HirDiff` + classification), `migrate` (identity), `project`, `OpaqueProcess`
   + `CapabilityDeclarationRecord` (15 tri-state fields), and a canonical-bytes ops seam
   (AC-IR-10). Deterministic ≥100-definition corpus for AC-IR-06.

## Gap table
| gap | disposition |
|---|---|
| `seal` cannot pin refs topologically — `Permission.holder ↔ AgentProcess.permissions` is cyclic by construction | **Fixed** — member `version_id`s computed over the authored (pre-pin) canonical form; pinning is a definition-level binding, not member content (ADR-0231) |
| `classify_home` silent on the two leaves (`Text`, `CompiledPayload`) — DF-S1.1-1 wants all fifteen homed | **Interim ruling** — `Text`→P1, `CompiledPayload`→P2 under ADR-0216/OQ-467, recorded in ADR-0231; lifts with WS-A2/WS-A3 ratification |
| `tool` → `environment` mint had no sealed-definition context to consult | **DF-S1.3-3 closed** — `MintingContext`/`default_authority_in`; `seal` populates `closed_world_tools` from the definition's own `ToolCapability` declarations (ADR-0232) |
| diff path syntax ambiguous for map keys containing `.` (budget dims like `tokens.total`) | **Fixed** — quoted `["key"]` segments; emitter and parser symmetric (ADR-0231) |
| `opacity`/`ablate` ops | **Spec-deferred** — Stage 3 (§3.1.14 staging), not this ticket |
| `rebase`, OpaqueProcess probing, agent-spec export/import | **Spec-deferred** — C1/C2 staging, not this ticket |
| AC-IR-02 two-profile *compile* | **Stage-3 half** — needs §3.2 compilation; the deterministic half (surface/semantic split + T-LCD-01 statics) is executable and green |
| clippy `manual_is_multiple_of`, `assertions_on_constants`, `redundant_closure` in tests | Fixed — `is_multiple_of`, `const { assert!(..) }`, `any(&f)` |
